intro:
Practical reading on how to meditate, what the main methods are, and which health claims to decline.

The map is the [Meditation topic](/topics/meditation/). The pages below are the narrower reading. Use one page for one question, then come back if you need the wider argument. This collection is not a ladder and not a product.

sections.heading: Which pages are gathered here?
sections.content:
The current set includes [/articles/meditation-for-beginners/](/articles/meditation-for-beginners/), [/articles/daily-meditation-practice/](/articles/daily-meditation-practice/), [/articles/what-is-meditation/](/articles/what-is-meditation/), [/articles/meditation-vs-mindfulness/](/articles/meditation-vs-mindfulness/), [/meditation/mindfulness/](/meditation/mindfulness/), [/meditation/breath-awareness/](/meditation/breath-awareness/). Titles can be read on the pages themselves. If a link is the definition, prefer it to a secondary comment. If a link is a comparison, it assumes you have seen at least one of the things compared.

New pages will be added when they have a distinct job. A repeated city page or a keyword variant will not be added. The [editorial policy](/editorial-policy/) is the reason. Suggestions can go through the [contact](/contact/) page.

sections.heading: How should health language be read?
sections.content: Where a practice is sold as medicine, read the [disclaimer](/disclaimer/) before you change your care. Government summaries and classical texts answer different questions, and this guide will not pretend they are one source. A traditional hope is labeled as a hope. A research summary is linked. Neither becomes a promise because it sits on a guide page.

key_takeaways: The meditation topic pillar is the map.
Each linked page answers a narrower question.
Health claims stay tied to the disclaimer and the cited sources.

faq.question: Are these instructions for a course?
faq.answer: No. They are reading paths through the publication. They do not enroll you in a program.

faq.question: What if two pages seem to overlap?
faq.answer: Use the pillar for the overview and the article for the specific question. They link to each other on purpose.
